listed_quote.quote: the Boards of Directors/Trustees of each of BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE:BKT), BlackRock Income Opportunity Trust, Inc. (NYSE:BNA) and BlackRock Core Bond Trust (NYSE:BHK) have approved the reorganization of each of BKT and BNA into BHK, with BHK continuing as the surviving fund

announcement.quote: BlackRock Advisors, LLC announced today that the Boards of Directors/Trustees of each of BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE:BKT), BlackRock Income Opportunity Trust, Inc. (NYSE:BNA) and BlackRock Core Bond Trust (NYSE:BHK) have approved the reorganization of each of BKT and BNA into BHK, with BHK continuing as the surviving fund

deals.notes: Joint special shareholder meeting set for 2014-09-30; reminder 425s filed 2014-08-29, 2014-09-10 and 2014-09-18 ask for votes. No filing in the excerpts states a result or completion. The 2015-06-12 DEF 14A (compact excerpt) is an annual-meeting proxy listing BKT among the filers; its excerpt says nothing about the merger.
